description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Urabrask, Blood Funnel and Prismari Pianist trigger.
Resolve the Urabrask trigger, adding {R} and dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Prismari Pianist trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature token.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.
